newsitem.title: USA: EA restructures, $3 mln in costs to hurt Q3.
newsitem.headline: EA restructures, $3 mln in costs to hurt Q3.

text.p: EA Engineering, Science and Technology Inc said it has restructured operations and will report about $3 million in third quarter severance and recruitment expenses as well as costs associated with a reduction in office space.
It said it has restructured operations into branch offices, and has cut about 125 staff nationwide. These actions are expected to reduce annualized expenses by over $8 million, EA said.
EA said the reorganization is designed to enhance accountability in branch offices and to focus on client needs.
EA said third quarter restructuring expenses also include costs incurred from the suspension of the implementation of a new project/financial system.
The company earlier reported a second quarter loss of $0.40 per share. It said the loss is primarily due to a slowdown in authorizations from federal contracts and a weak private sector market.
It said higher expenses, lower volumes at its analytical chemistry laboratory and unrecoverable costs on certain projects heightened operating losses.

"Today's actions, along with those at the end of the second quarter, will cumulatively reduce EA's annual operating and overhead costs by more than $9 million," new company president and chief executive officer Donald Deieso said.

"EA is now poised to return to operating profitability. We will turn our focus to project opportunities in our core capabilities... We will also continue to carefully pursue international opportunities through our international client base."
